facts.value: A community is a group of people.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: It has a delimited geographic area or locality.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: It is marked by a common culture and social system.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: There exists a consciousness among the members about their unity and sense of belongingness.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Members of a community act collectively in an organised manner. Mostly there exists a division of labour in a community.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: A community is not deliberately created, it establishes in a natural way. It is much more stable and permanent.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Informal means of social control are used in a community.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

facts.value: Simply put, a community is a territorial group of people, who share a common geographic area and culture and also have a feeling of belongingness (community sentiment).
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy
